name: Data Protection Officer Designation and Contact Publication
objective: Ensure there is a designated point of contact for grievance redressal based in India and that their business contact details are publicly accessible.
description: The Bank designates a Data Protection Officer based in India as the point of contact for grievance redressal and publishes their business contact details on the Bank's website and mobile application.
evidence_expected: Screenshots or links of the website and mobile application displaying DPO contact details

source.quote: 2.1 Data Protection Officer [DPR-C01]. The Bank shall designate a Data Protection Officer based in India who shall be the point of contact for grievance redressal, and shall publish the business contact details of the Data Protection Officer on its website and mobile application. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Annual DPIA and Independent Data Audit
objective: Assess data protection risks and compliance through annual assessments and audits, reporting outcomes to the Board Risk Management Committee.
description: The Bank conducts an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit, and reports the outcome to the Board Risk Management Committee.
evidence_expected: Board Risk Management Committee meeting minutes showing outcome reporting

source.quote: 2.2 DPIA and independent data audit [DPR-C02]. The Bank shall conduct an annual Data Protection Impact Assessment and an independent data audit, and report the outcome to the Board Risk Management Committee. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Annual

name: Privacy Notice at Collection
objective: Ensure customers are provided with a privacy notice describing processed personal data and purposes in their preferred language prior to or during consent requests.
description: Every request for consent is accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data to be processed and the purpose of processing, available in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, at the customer's option.
evidence_expected: Privacy notice templates in supported languages
System logs or UI screenshots showing notice presentation prior to consent

source.quote: 3.1 Privacy notice at collection [DPR-C03]. Every request for consent shall be accompanied or preceded by a notice describing the personal data to be processed and the purpose of processing, available in English or any language specified in the Eighth Schedule to the Constitution, at the customer's option. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Consent Capture and Logging
objective: Ensure valid, purpose-specific consent is obtained via clear affirmative action and properly logged with traceability details.
description: Consent is obtained through a clear affirmative action, made specific to each purpose, and logged with timestamp, purpose code, and notice version.
evidence_expected: Consent management system audit logs containing timestamp, purpose code, and notice version
UI workflow evidence of affirmative action

source.quote: 3.2 Consent capture and logging [DPR-C04]. Consent shall be obtained through a clear affirmative action, shall be specific to each purpose, and shall be logged with timestamp, purpose code and notice version. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Purpose Limitation and Data Inventory Maintenance
objective: Ensure personal data is processed strictly in accordance with consent or lawful purposes and maintain an accurate inventory of data categories, purposes, and systems.
description: The Bank ensures personal data is processed only for consented or legally permitted purposes and maintains an inventory of personal data categories, purposes, and systems.
evidence_expected: Data inventory document covering personal data categories, purposes, and systems

source.quote: 4.1 Purpose limitation and data inventory [DPR-C05]. Personal data shall be processed only for the purpose for which consent was given or for legitimate uses permitted by law, and the Bank shall maintain an inventory of personal data categories, purposes and systems. Control owner: Data Protection Officer. Frequency: Annual

name: Children's Personal Data Consent and Monitoring Restriction
objective: To protect children's personal data by ensuring verifiable parental/guardian consent is obtained before processing and prohibiting tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising.
description: The Bank obtains verifiable consent from a parent or lawful guardian before processing personal data of a child, and restricts tracking, behavioral monitoring, or targeted advertising directed at children.
evidence_expected: Verifiable parental or guardian consent records
System configuration reviews confirming absence of tracking/behavioral monitoring for child profiles

source.quote: Before processing personal data of a child, the Bank shall obtain verifiable consent of the parent or lawful guardian and shall not undertake tracking, behavioural monitoring or targeted advertising directed at children

name: Reasonable Security Safeguards for Personal Data
objective: To prevent personal data breaches by implementing technical safeguards including encryption, masking, and access control.
description: The Bank implements reasonable security safeguards such as encryption, masking, and access control to prevent personal data breaches across relevant systems.
evidence_expected: Access control lists and user privilege review logs

source.quote: The Bank shall implement reasonable security safeguards, including encryption, masking and access control, to prevent personal data breach

name: Annual Review of Personal Data Retention Schedule
objective: To ensure that retention periods for all categories of personal data remain appropriate and are reviewed periodically.
description: Retention periods for each category of personal data are specified in the Retention Schedule at Annexure A and undergo an annual review.
evidence_expected: Review meeting minutes or sign-off logs

source.quote: Retention periods for each category of personal data shall be specified in the Retention Schedule at Annexure A, which shall be reviewed annually

name: Erasure of Customer Personal Data After Account Closure
objective: To ensure customer personal data and KYC documents are permanently deleted from all systems within the mandated timeframe following account closure.
description: Personal data of customers with closed accounts, including KYC documents, are erased from all applicable systems within the specified timeframe after account closure.
evidence_expected: System reports confirming successful erasure within the 180-day window

source.quote: Personal data of customers whose accounts have been closed, including KYC documents, shall be erased from all systems within 180 days of account closure

name: Data Principal Request Resolution
objective: To ensure Data Principal requests for access, correction, completion, or updating of personal data are resolved in a timely manner.
description: Requests from Data Principals regarding access, correction, completion, or updating of their personal data are processed and resolved within the mandated timeframe from receipt.
evidence_expected: Communication records sent to data principals

source.quote: Requests from Data Principals for access to, correction, completion or updating of their personal data shall be resolved within 30 days of receipt

name: Board policy approval and CISO appointment
objective: Ensure proper governance, oversight, and independent reporting of information security by establishing board approval for the policy and appointing an independent Chief Information Security Officer.
description: The Board approves the Information Security Policy, and the Bank appoints a Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) who reports independently of the IT function.
evidence_expected: Organizational chart showing CISO reporting line independent of IT

source.quote: 2.1 Board policy and CISO [ISB-C01]. The Board shall approve this Policy and the Bank shall appoint a Chief Information Security Officer reporting independently of the IT function. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Annual

name: Role-based access and leaver revocation
objective: Prevent unauthorized access by ensuring system access is granted strictly based on user roles and that access for departing employees is revoked promptly upon exit.
description: Access to information systems is granted on a role basis, and access for leavers is revoked within one working day of their exit by the Head of IT Operations.
evidence_expected: Access request forms and role authorization matrix
IT revocation logs showing timestamps of account disablement

source.quote: 3.1 Role-based access and leaver revocation [ISB-C02]. Access to information systems shall be granted on a role basis, and access of leavers shall be revoked within one working day of exit. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Quarterly review of internal privileged accounts
objective: Detect and prevent unauthorized privileged access by periodically validating that all active internal privileged accounts remain appropriate.
description: System owners conduct a review of all internal privileged accounts every quarter.
evidence_expected: Signed review sign-off sheets or review audit trails

source.quote: 3.2 Quarterly review of internal privileged accounts [ISB-C03]. All internal privileged accounts shall be reviewed every quarter by the system owner. Control owner: System Owners. Frequency: Quarterly

name: Multi-factor authentication enforcement
objective: Protect sensitive access points and mitigate the risk of compromised credentials by requiring multiple forms of verification for privileged and remote access.
description: Multi-factor authentication is enforced continuously for all privileged and remote access by the Head of IT Operations.

source.quote: 3.3 Multi-factor authentication [ISB-C04]. Multi-factor authentication shall be enforced for all privileged and remote access. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Continuous

name: Vulnerability management and remediation
objective: Identify security weaknesses through regular assessments and ensure timely mitigation of critical vulnerabilities to reduce risk exposure.
description: Vulnerability assessments are conducted every quarter, and any critical vulnerabilities identified must be remediated within 15 days of identification under the oversight of the CISO.
evidence_expected: Vulnerability remediation tracking logs and closure tickets

source.quote: 4.1 Vulnerability management [ISB-C05]. Vulnerability assessments shall be conducted every quarter, and critical vulnerabilities shall be remediated within 15 days of identification. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Quarterly

name: ICT System Log Retention Control
objective: Ensure all ICT system logs are securely maintained within Indian jurisdiction for audit and forensic purposes.
description: Logs of all ICT systems are maintained securely within Indian jurisdiction for a rolling period of 180 days by the Head of IT Operations.
evidence_expected: Storage verification reports showing logs retained within Indian jurisdiction

source.quote: Logs of all ICT systems shall be maintained securely within Indian jurisdiction for a rolling period of 180 days. Control owner: Head of IT Operations. Frequency: Continuous

name: Data Encryption Standards Control
objective: Protect sensitive data confidentiality and integrity both at rest and in transit using robust cryptographic standards.
description: Data at rest is encrypted using AES-256 or stronger and data in transit is protected using TLS 1.2 or higher, overseen by the Chief Information Security Officer.
evidence_expected: Database and storage encryption configuration reports
TLS cipher suite configuration reports for in-transit communication

source.quote: Data at rest shall be encrypted using AES-256 or stronger and data in transit shall be protected using TLS 1.2 or higher. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Continuous

name: Cyber Incident Reporting Control
objective: Ensure timely escalation and reporting of cyber security incidents to regulatory authorities.
description: Cyber security incidents are reported to CERT-In within six hours of being noticed and to the Reserve Bank of India within the timelines prescribed by it, managed by the Chief Information Security Officer.
evidence_expected: Copies of submitted incident reports to CERT-In and RBI with timestamp proof

source.quote: Cyber security incidents shall be reported to CERT-In within six hours of being noticed and to the Reserve Bank of India within the timelines prescribed by it. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Security Awareness Training Control
objective: Ensure all employees maintain adequate awareness of information security policies and threats.
description: All employees complete information security awareness training annually, overseen by the Head of HR.

source.quote: All employees shall complete information security awareness training annually. Control owner: Head of HR. Frequency: Annual

name: Board policy and IT Strategy Committee oversight
objective: Ensure appropriate governance, Board approval of the policy, and IT Strategy Committee oversight of all IT outsourcing arrangements.
description: The Board approves the IT Outsourcing Policy, and the IT Strategy Committee oversees all IT outsourcing arrangements and reviews the policy at least annually.

source.quote: The Board shall approve this Policy, and the IT Strategy Committee shall oversee all IT outsourcing arrangements and review this Policy at least annually

name: Materiality assessment and register
objective: Assess the criticality of IT outsourcing arrangements prior to onboarding and maintain a comprehensive register.
description: Each IT outsourcing arrangement is assessed for materiality before onboarding, and all arrangements are recorded in the Outsourcing Register with their materiality classification.

source.quote: Each IT outsourcing arrangement shall be assessed for materiality before onboarding, and all arrangements shall be recorded in the Outsourcing Register with their materiality classification

name: Service provider due diligence
objective: Ensure that prospective service providers are thoroughly evaluated across financial, technical, reputational, and security dimensions before engagement.
description: Before entering into an arrangement, the Bank conducts due diligence on the service provider covering financial soundness, technical capability, reputation, and information security posture.

source.quote: Before entering into an arrangement, the Bank shall conduct due diligence on the service provider covering financial soundness, technical capability, reputation and information security posture

name: Audit and access rights in contracts
objective: Ensure contractual rights for the Bank and regulators to access and audit service providers, along with necessary protective clauses.
description: Every outsourcing agreement provides for the right of the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India, or persons authorised by them, to access and audit the service provider, together with clauses on confidentiality, sub-contracting, and termination.

source.quote: Every outsourcing agreement shall provide for the right of the Bank and the Reserve Bank of India, or persons authorised by them, to access and audit the service provider, together with clauses on confidentiality, sub-contracting and termination

name: Annual risk assessment of material providers
objective: Monitor ongoing risks associated with material service providers and report results to governance bodies.
description: Material service providers are subjected to a risk assessment at least annually, and the results are reported to the IT Strategy Committee.
evidence_expected: IT Strategy Committee meeting minutes noting the reports

source.quote: Material service providers shall be subjected to a risk assessment at least annually, and the results shall be reported to the IT Strategy Committee

name: Quarterly review of service-provider privileged access
objective: To ensure that privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems is reviewed and unauthorized or no longer required access is revoked.
description: Privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems shall be reviewed every quarter, and access that is no longer required shall be revoked.
evidence_expected: Access revocation records for service-provider personnel

source.quote: 5.2 Quarterly review of service-provider privileged access [ITO-C06]. Privileged access granted to service-provider personnel on Bank systems shall be reviewed every quarter, and access that is no longer required shall be revoked. Control owner: Chief Information Security Officer. Frequency: Quarterly

name: Concentration risk monitoring
objective: To monitor and report concentration risk arising from reliance on a single service provider.
description: Concentration risk arising from reliance on a single service provider shall be monitored and reported to the IT Strategy Committee every six months.
evidence_expected: IT Strategy Committee meeting minutes documenting the review

source.quote: 5.3 Concentration risk monitoring [ITO-C07]. Concentration risk arising from reliance on a single service provider shall be monitored and reported to the IT Strategy Committee every six months. Control owner: Chief Information Officer. Frequency: Semi Annual

name: Joint DR drill with material providers
objective: To ensure business continuity and disaster recovery readiness for material outsourcing arrangements through joint drills.
description: For each material outsourcing arrangement, the Bank shall maintain a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan with the service provider and conduct a joint disaster recovery drill at least annually.
evidence_expected: Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan documents
Joint disaster recovery drill test reports and results

source.quote: 6.1 Joint DR drill with material providers [ITO-C08]. For each material outsourcing arrangement, the Bank shall maintain a Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery plan with the service provider and conduct a joint disaster recovery drill at least annually. Control owner: Head of IT Infrastructure. Frequency: Annual

name: Exit strategy
objective: To maintain a documented exit strategy and transition arrangements for every material outsourcing arrangement.
description: A documented exit strategy, including transition arrangements, shall be maintained for every material outsourcing arrangement.
evidence_expected: Transition arrangement plans for material outsourcing contracts

source.quote: 6.2 Exit strategy [ITO-C09]. A documented exit strategy, including transition arrangements, shall be maintained for every material outsourcing arrangement. Control owner: Head of Vendor Management. Frequency: Annual

name: Board approval and annual review of KYC Policy
objective: Ensure the KYC Policy remains current and complies with regulatory standards through regular board oversight.
description: The KYC Policy shall be approved by the Board of Directors and reviewed at least annually, or earlier upon any material regulatory change by the Chief Compliance Officer.
evidence_expected: Approved KYC Policy document with version history and sign-offs

source.quote: 3.1 Board approval and annual review of KYC Policy [KYC-C01]. This Policy shall be approved by the Board of Directors and reviewed at least annually, or earlier upon any material regulatory change. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Annual

name: Designated Director and Principal Officer Appointment and Communication
objective: Ensure proper regulatory reporting and accountability by formally designating and communicating key compliance roles to FIU-IND.
description: The Bank shall nominate a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicate their names, designation and contact details to FIU-IND, including upon any change, managed by the Chief Compliance Officer.

source.quote: 3.2 Designated Director and Principal Officer [KYC-C02]. The Bank shall nominate a Designated Director and a Principal Officer and communicate their names, designation and contact details to FIU-IND, including upon any change. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Prohibition of Anonymous or Fictitious Accounts
objective: Prevent money laundering and fraudulent account opening by blocking activation for unverified customers.
description: No account shall be opened in an anonymous or fictitious name. The Core Banking System shall block account activation unless the customer's OVD has been verified.
evidence_expected: Core Banking System audit logs of blocked account activations

source.quote: 4.1 No anonymous or fictitious accounts [KYC-C03]. No account shall be opened in an anonymous or fictitious name. The Core Banking System shall block account activation unless the customer's OVD has been verified. Control owner: Head of Retail Operations. Frequency: Continuous

name: V-CIP Conduct Standards and Verification
objective: Ensure the integrity and authenticity of Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) during customer onboarding.
description: Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) sessions shall be conducted only by trained officials of the Bank, recorded end-to-end, geo-tagged and subjected to a liveness check before the account is activated.

source.quote: 4.2 V-CIP conduct standards [KYC-C04]. Video-based Customer Identification Process (V-CIP) sessions shall be conducted only by trained officials of the Bank, recorded end-to-end, geo-tagged and subjected to a liveness check before the account is activated. Control owner: Head of Digital Banking. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Identity Verification at Onboarding
objective: Verify the legally valid identity and address of every individual customer at the time of onboarding.
description: At onboarding, the identity and address of every individual customer shall be verified using an OVD or Aadhaar-based e-KYC authentication, and the outcome shall be recorded in the onboarding system.

source.quote: 5.1 Identity verification at onboarding [KYC-C05]. At onboarding, the identity and address of every individual customer shall be verified using an OVD or Aadhaar-based e-KYC authentication, and the outcome shall be recorded in the onboarding system. Control owner: Head of Retail Operations. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Beneficial Owner Identification and Attestation
objective: To identify and verify beneficial owners of legal entity customers in accordance with PML Rules and mitigate money laundering risks.
description: For legal entity customers, the Bank identifies the beneficial owner(s) according to PML Rules thresholds, takes reasonable measures to verify their identity, and the Relationship Manager records a beneficial ownership attestation.
evidence_expected: Identity verification documents for beneficial owners

source.quote: 5.2 Beneficial owner identification [KYC-C06]. For customers that are legal entities, the Bank shall identify the beneficial owner(s) as per the thresholds prescribed under the PML Rules and take reasonable measures to verify their identity. The Relationship Manager shall record a beneficial ownership attestation for each such customer. Control owner: Head of SME Banking. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Sanctions Screening Before Account Activation
objective: To prevent onboarding of sanctioned individuals or entities by screening customer names against UNSC and UAPA sanction lists before account activation.
description: Customer names are screened against UNSC sanctions lists and lists of individuals/entities designated under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967 prior to account activation. Activation is blocked until screening is cleared.
evidence_expected: Screening clearance reports prior to account activation

source.quote: 5.3 Sanctions screening before activation [KYC-C07]. Before any account is activated, the customer's name shall be screened against the UNSC sanctions lists and the lists of individuals and entities designated under the Unlawful Activities (Prevention) Act, 1967. Activation shall not proceed until screening is cleared. Control owner: Head of AML Operations. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Customer Risk Categorisation and Trigger Review
objective: To ensure every customer is appropriately risk-rated (Low, Medium, or High) at onboarding and reviewed upon trigger events.
description: Every customer is assigned a risk category (Low, Medium, or High) at onboarding based on profile, geography, product, and channel, and the category is reviewed upon any trigger event.
evidence_expected: Customer risk assessment records at onboarding

source.quote: 6.1 Customer risk categorisation [KYC-C08]. Every customer shall be assigned a risk category of Low, Medium or High at onboarding based on customer profile, geography, product and channel, and the category shall be reviewed upon any trigger event. Control owner: Chief Compliance Officer. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Periodic KYC Updation - High Risk
objective: To maintain up-to-date KYC information for High risk customers through regular periodic reviews.
description: Periodic updation of KYC is carried out at least once every two years for High risk customers.
evidence_expected: Updated KYC records for High risk customers

source.quote: 6.2 Periodic KYC updation - High risk [KYC-C09]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every two years for High risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations. Frequency: Biennial

name: Periodic KYC Updation - Medium Risk
objective: To maintain up-to-date KYC information for Medium risk customers through periodic reviews.
description: Periodic updation of KYC is carried out at least once every ten years for Medium risk customers.
evidence_expected: Updated KYC files for Medium risk customers

source.quote: 6.3 Periodic KYC updation - Medium risk [KYC-C10]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Medium risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations

name: Periodic KYC updation - Low risk
objective: Ensure KYC records for low risk customers are kept current and accurate over time.
description: Periodic updation of KYC is carried out at least once every ten years for Low risk customers by KYC Operations.
evidence_expected: Compliance review logs for low-risk customers

source.quote: 6.4 Periodic KYC updation - Low risk [KYC-C11]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every ten years for Low risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations

name: Alert review and STR filing
objective: Detect suspicious transactions through monitoring alerts and ensure timely filing of Suspicious Transaction Reports (STR) to FIU-IND.
description: Transaction monitoring alerts are reviewed by AML Operations. When a transaction is determined to be suspicious, a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) is furnished to FIU-IND within seven working days of such determination.

source.quote: 6.5 Alert review and STR filing [KYC-C12]. Transaction monitoring alerts shall be reviewed by AML Operations, and where a transaction is determined to be suspicious, a Suspicious Transaction Report (STR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND within seven working days of such determination. Control owner: Principal Officer. Frequency: Event Driven

name: Cash Transaction Reports
objective: Ensure timely reporting of cash transactions to the financial intelligence unit as required by regulations.
description: Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) are furnished to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month.

source.quote: 7.1 Cash Transaction Reports [KYC-C13]. Cash Transaction Reports (CTR) shall be furnished to FIU-IND for every month by the 15th day of the succeeding month. Control owner: Principal Officer. Frequency: Monthly

name: Record preservation - five years
objective: Ensure all transaction records, customer identification documents, KYC records, and account files are retained for the regulatory minimum period after relationship termination.
description: Records of all transactions and customer identification, including KYC documents and account files, are preserved for at least five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later.

source.quote: 7.2 Record preservation - five years [KYC-C14]. Records of all transactions and of customer identification, including KYC documents and account files, shall be preserved for at least five years after the business relationship has ended or the account has been closed, whichever is later. Control owner: Head of Operations. Frequency: Continuous
